mapper.sql: SELECT emp18_relate_file_id AS relate_file_id, emp18_person_id AS person_id, emp18_note AS note, sys10_file_id AS file_id, sys10_reg_date AS reg_date, sys10_file_nm AS file_name, sys10_size AS size FROM emp18_relate_file INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp18_person_id = emp01_person_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sys10_file ON emp18_relate_file_id = sys10_parent_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM emp18_relate_file WHERE emp18_person_id IN (SELECT emp01_person_id FROM emp01_person WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId}) AND emp18_relate_file_id IN #{id}
